title: Reliability Engineering Stress Testing: Steering Under Distribution-Shifted Inputs

original_idea.body: Stress-test a steering vector across progressively OOD inputs (languages, code, formats, long contexts); build a stress-failure profile. Inference-only.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Plausible chain: a stress envelope prevents silent OOD steering failures, but the catastrophic-risk link is indirect (level 3).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Apply vector across OOD input families + measure efficacy; clear methodology, assembling OOD sets adds modest effort (level 4).

narrow_scope.reasoning: Broad stress battery (languages, code, formats, long contexts) per concept leans multi-workstream (level 3).

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Independent-friendly OOD robustness study on open models (level 4).

low_compute.reasoning: Inference-only across input families, single GPU (level 4).

novelty.reasoning: OOD brittleness of steering noted; consolidated stress-profile framing may add modest novelty.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Steering OOD fragility documented; the stress-profile catalogue may add novelty.
